global_rules.touch_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px for all interactive elements.
global_rules.safe_area: All screens must wrap content in SafeAreaView or use useSafeAreaInsets().
global_rules.styling_approach: React Native StyleSheet / inline styles (or Tailwind if configured in Expo via NativeWind). We assume standard RN StyleSheet for this spec.

floating.description: Continuous slow vertical translation mimicking breathing/floating.

press.description: Scale down to 0.96 on press for buttons and interactive cards.

button.primary: Background #D4AF37, Text #000000, BorderRadius pill, PaddingVertical 16px, MinHeight 56px. Font Manrope_700Bold.
button.secondary: Background transparent, Border 1px #D4AF37, Text #D4AF37, BorderRadius pill, PaddingVertical 16px.

card.default: Background #121218, Border 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05), BorderRadius 16px, Padding 24px. Ambient shadow.
card.premium: Background #1A1A24, Border 1px rgba(212,175,55,0.3), BorderRadius 16px, Padding 24px. Subtle gold glow.

input.default: Background rgba(255,255,255,0.03), BorderBottom 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.2), Color #FFFFFF, MinHeight 56px. Placeholder #5A5A65.

bottom_sheet.default: Background #121218, TopLeft/TopRight Radius 24px, subtle handle indicator at top.

Onboarding.layout: Hero image background (abstract gold/black), overlay gradient from transparent to #0A0A0E at bottom. Text at bottom: Playfair Display H1, Manrope Body. 'Get Started' primary button with floating animation.
Onboarding.features: Email/Phone OTP inputs shown in a sliding BottomSheet.

Dashboard.layout: Top section: Total Estate Value with large typography. Middle: Quick stats (X Assets, Y Family Members, Z Scenarios). Bottom: Recent AI insights. Use a floating 'Sparkle' icon for AI Chat FAB.
Dashboard.navigation: Bottom Tab Navigation (Dashboard, Assets, Family, Scenarios).

AssetManagement.layout: List of assets categorized by Property, Business, Investments. Cards use 'default' styling. Floating Action Button (FAB) to Add Asset.

FamilyManagement.layout: List of members. Avatar placeholders. Display age, relationship, and small chips for 'Financial Needs'. Exclude Family Tree view entirely. Focus on list/card view.

Scenarios.layout: Carousel or horizontal scroll of different Scenarios. Inside a Scenario: List of assets with slider/input to allocate percentage to family members. Top right: 'Fairness Score' dial. 'Export PDF' button in header.

AIChat.layout: Dark chat interface. User messages align right, gray bubble. AI messages align left, #121218 bubble with gold left border. Input bar at bottom with glassmorphism blur.

hero_background.description: Abstract golden metallic curves on black. Use as full-screen onboarding background.

premium_texture.description: Abstract dark geometric pattern. Use for empty states or subtle card backgrounds.

estate_placeholder.description: White concrete luxury architecture. Use as a placeholder for Property assets.

fabric_accent.description: Dark blue/black fabric texture. Use for premium headers or modal backgrounds.

testing.required_attributes: Add testID prop (React Native equivalent to data-testid) to all interactive elements, e.g., testID='login-submit-button'.
